alt: Top-down view of Camila's ringed hands arranging sliced magazine faces beside a green cutting mat scattered with cut-out eyes and lips.
description: Colour photo (the file name says bw, it is not black and white). Seen from above, Camila sits cross-legged in an orange patterned outfit at the top of the frame, both hands on an open magazine where a model's face has been sliced into three stacked strips; the green cutting mat with cut-out eyes, lips and a craft knife sits to the left. The whole floor is covered edge to edge with magazine pages, so there is no empty space: the calmest patch is the grey-green page at middle right. Warm, soft indoor light with an orange cast. Near-twin of bw-97; do not place the two side by side.

alt: Close-up of Camila's hands on a green cutting mat: one holds a craft knife, the other pins a strip of a magazine face among cut-out eyes.
description: The tightest and cleanest of the set. The green gridded mat fills the frame on a slight tilt; one hand with a craft knife comes in at top left, the other, with a large silver ring and painted nails, presses down a strip of a face at right, with three cut-out eyes and torn black strips between them. Focus is sharp on the mat and falls off softly at the edges: a blurred black-and-white magazine face at far left and a dark band along the bottom are the quiet areas. Warm low light.

alt: From above, Camila bends over a green cutting mat, long brown hair hiding her face, cutting a strip of a magazine face with a craft knife.
description: Top-down. Camila leans in from the top of the frame with her hair falling forward so no face is seen; her hands meet at the centre of the tilted green mat, one cutting with a pen-style knife, the other (large dark ring) holding the paper still. An open magazine with a black text column fills the left third, loose pages surround the mat and a box of pens sits at bottom right. No empty space; the hair is a large dark-brown mass across the top centre. Warm indoor light.

alt: Low side view of Camila in a white T-shirt leaning over her cutting mat, hair falling forward, ringed hands at work, foreground blurred.
description: Tall frame shot from table height. Camila leans in from the upper left, her face cropped just above the mouth, long brown hair filling the left and centre; her hands with rings and a beaded bracelet work in the middle of the frame while the green mat and its cut-out eyes and lips are a blur in the bottom third. Dark and warm, with an orange wall glowing behind. Almost nothing is crisp, so it works as atmosphere rather than as a picture to study.
qualityNote: Dark, with very shallow focus: the hands and the mat are soft and nothing is truly sharp. Fine small or as a dimmed background, not large as a feature.

alt: Flat lay of a green cutting mat holding a face pieced together from mismatched magazine eyes, lips and hair, ringed by magazine pages.
description: Tall top-down still life with no hands. The green mat sits just below centre with a collage in progress on it: a face built from two different eyes, oversized lips, a block of hair and torn black strips. Around it are layered magazine pages (an older person with blond hair and tinted glasses, a hand-drawn eye, a make-up advert, denim, a blue page with a stone building) and an open magazine across the bottom; the only plain patches are small orange corners at bottom left and right. Even, warm light and sharp throughout. Much of the printed text is upside-down or sideways.
words: Camera Spotlight | Blackmagic Pocket Cinema Camera 6K

alt: Green cutting mat with a face assembled from cut-out magazine eyes, lips and hair, beside a blank spiral sketchbook and open magazines.
description: Angled view of the work surface with no hands. The mat lies centre-right on a diagonal carrying the collage in progress: two single eyes, a strip of a face with eyes and red lips, a second pair of lips, hair and torn black strips. A blank spiral-bound sketchbook fills the top left and is the one real empty area in this whole set (roughly the left half of the top third); an open magazine runs down the left edge and a magazine photo of an older person in tinted glasses sits top right. Warm even light, sharp on the mat.

alt: From above, Camila's hands place a cut-out eye and a pair of lips on a mostly empty green cutting mat, orange patterned clothing behind.
description: Top-down, early in the process. Camila sits cross-legged in orange patterned fabric across the top; one hand pins a cut-out eye to the mat with a fingertip, the other (big dark ring) holds a cut-out pair of lips, and a second eye lies between them. The lower half of the mat is clear green grid, the most open area of the frame. Torn make-up adverts in peach and red fill the left side and a grey photo of boots the right. Warm soft light, sharp on the hands.

alt: Top-down view of Camila's hands setting cut-out eyes, lips and torn black strips on a green cutting mat, scissors and magazines around.
description: Top-down. One hand with a beaded bracelet and silver rings reaches down the middle of the tilted mat to place a cut-out eye, the other, with a large engraved silver ring, steadies a torn black strip at lower right; an eye and a pair of lips lie between them. Orange clothing and a little hair fill the top right, floral-handled scissors and torn make-up adverts the left. No empty space apart from patches of green grid. Warm light; the mat is sharp, the edges of the frame slightly soft.

alt: From above, Camila leans over an open magazine laying a cut strip of one face across another, her cutting mat of eyes and lips to the left.
description: Top-down. Camila bends in from the top with auburn-brown hair falling across the upper centre and her arms forming a V, face unseen. Her right hand, wearing a watch ring, rests on an upside-down magazine portrait that has a strip of a different face laid across it; her left hand rests on the green mat at the left, which holds a cut-out eye, lips, another eye and a black strip. Orange fabric fills the top right. No empty space. Warm light, sharp on the magazine face.

alt: Camila sits cross-legged among magazines, lifting a cut piece from a model's face on an open page, cutting mat of eyes and lips beside her.
description: The widest view of the whole scene, from above. Camila in an orange patterned outfit fills the top right; both hands are on an open magazine at the centre, lifting a cut section off an upside-down face, while the green mat at the left carries three cut-out eyes, lips, torn strips and a craft knife. Magazine pages cover every bit of floor, with a text page at far left, fashion pages along the bottom and a stack of magazine spines at bottom right, so there is no empty space. Warm soft light, sharp throughout. Near-twin of bw-100, a moment earlier; do not place the two side by side.

alt: Two white-framed collages hung one above the other on a concrete block wall marked with orange spray paint, a small label beside them.
description: Still frame from the exhibition clip, tall phone format (720 x 1280). Two white-matted, white-framed collages hang one above the other on a raw concrete block wall with a band of orange spray paint between them. The upper piece, cut off at the top of the frame and carrying reflections on its glass, is Lucky Pleasures (hot pink ground, a cigarette pack at lower right); the lower piece, shown whole, is a black-and-white and red collage with an old camera, newspaper clippings and three faces, and it is not in the shop catalogue. A small purple-bordered wall label sits to the right of the lower frame; it is soft, appears to read "The Camera (2023)", and its price line cannot be read, so do not quote it as fact. Empty space: the concrete wall down the right edge.
words: MONKEES GET MOB WELCOME (partly cut off)
qualityNote: A 720 x 1280 video frame: soft, with light reflections on the upper frame's glass, the upper work cut off at the top and the picture slightly tilted. Fine as the poster for the clip or a small card; do not show wider than 720 px.
